title: bridgewatch-oncall-log-lucian-2027-11-09
content:
Bridgewatch shift notes — Lucian (overnight)
2027-11-09 -> 2027-11-10

Quick summary:
- 03:12 — Pager: surge of 5xxs from hosted inference edge. Alert: EDGE_5XX_RATE_HIGH.
- 03:16 — Rolled initial mitigation: scale edge-proxy pool + route traffic to fallback region (eu-west-2).
- 03:28 — Error rate dropped but latency spike remained for a subset of requests (long context prompts).
- 04:05 — Identified root cause (working hypothesis): LRU eviction + kv-cache churn on instances after new model rollout (v2.4.1) -> increased token decode misses -> CPU spike -> proxy timeouts.

Timeline / notes (rough):
- 03:12 alert fires (pager). Slack thread #oncall-shift: https://slack.redwood.ai/archives/CONN/abcd
- 03:13 check grafana panels: ingress 5xx, edge-cpu, kv-cache-hitrate. Query: avg(rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5..",handler=~"/v1/generate"}[1m])) by (instance)
- 03:15 ssh to edge-proxy-4, top shows high user cpu, java process busy decoding.
- 03:16 scaled edge-proxy pool + added 2 instances in staging cluster, then mirrored change to prod via autoscaler override.
- 03:18 temporary routing rule added to direct 20% traffic to eu-west-2 (fallback).
- 03:22 spike reduced but a tail of latency persisted. Correlated with model v2.4.1 start time (02:55 deploy).
- 03:30 found frequent kv-cache invalidation logs on model-server-*. Pattern: cache key eviction when sequence_length > 1024 and quantized-kv compatibility mismatch.
- 03:45 pinned traffic to model v2.3.9 for customers on SLO tier while we investigate.
- 04:05 confirmed hypothesis with Maya: model rollout changed serialization format for kv blobs (minor header byte) — older runtime didn't tolerate gracefully.
- 04:30 hotfix deployed: model-server runtime accepts legacy-kv headers (compat shim) + rehydrate cache gradually.
- 05:02 alerts quiet. Monitoring: keep an eye on cache hit rate and downstream 504s for next 6h.

Commands I ran (quick copy):
- kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=edge-proxy -o wide
- kubectl -n inference scale deployment/edge-proxy --replicas=10
- kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/model-server --to-revision=23 (pinned to v2.3.9 replica set)
- prometheus query used (Grafana explorer): sum(rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[2m])) by (model)

Immediate follow-ups (assign & due):
- ACTION: Add kv serialization compatibility tests to model onboarding checklist — owner: Maya Chen — due: 2027-11-16
- ACTION: Create a small integration test that simulates high-seq-length decode to exercise eviction path — owner: Lucian Park — due: 2027-11-12
- ACTION: Postmortem (mini) for EDGE_5XX_RATE_HIGH — owner: Ruth Patel (lead) + Lucian — draft due: 2027-11-12, final due: 2027-11-19
- ACTION: Add temporary alert suppression for non-SLO customers during rollouts (policy doc) — owner: Product-Hosted-API — ask in #product-api — due: 2027-11-20

Runbook TODOs (notes to self):
- runbook: edge-inference -> add section: "model serialization mismatch" with guided steps: detect (log patterns), pin traffic, deploy shim, rehydrate cache.
- runbook: add recommended queries (exact PromQL) to the top; include kinesis/logs grep patterns.
- update rollout playbook to include quick compatibility smoke on a canary modelserver group with long-seq prompts.

Observability items to raise (Ruth):
- Grafana panel for kv_cache_hit_rate by model and by instance (currently only cluster-wide).
- Add alert: KV_CACHE_EVICT_RATE_HIGH (new) with SLO-based thresholds.
- Trace example request flow through edge -> model-server showing time spent waiting on kv decode (zipkin trace link placeholder).

Things I tried that did NOT work (notes):
- Increasing proxy keepalive did not help the tail latency (misdirected).
- Manual eviction of caches on a single model-server pod made things worse (cache warmup needed).

Customer impact / comms:
- Affected ~8% of requests between 03:12-03:45; mostly long-context generation (>1024 tokens).
- CS notified via incident bridge (Ruth was pinged) and Channels: customer-facing incident note drafted but hold until postmortem.

Quick checklist for next handoff:
- Monitor grafana: edge 5xx, 95p latency for /v1/generate, kv_cache_hit_rate.
- Confirm pinned traffic still in place for SLO customers (prod routing rules).
- Leave a comment on JIRA-INC-4521 with timeline and links to logs.
- Follow-up sync with product about adding compatibility gate in release pipeline.

Notes to self / scratch:
- Write kernel of compatibility shim as library we can reuse across runtimes. Name: kv-compat-lib?
- Consider adding model metadata field: kv_compat_version during upload to model registry to gate runtime choices.
- Remind Maya to add a note in model onboarding doc: "avoid header format changes without compat flag"

Misc small TODOs (personal):
- Update personal oncall checklist with these new PromQL snippets by 2027-11-11.
- Change alarm ringtone: the 3am tone still wakes me but gives me heartburn.

End of shift handoff:
- Handoff to Ruth at 05:30. Left pinned list in the incident JIRA.
- Slack DM to Ruth with top 3: (1) watch kv_cache_hit_rate, (2) don't evict caches manually, (3) pin model traffic if needed.

Scratch appendix (logs + snippets):
- Sample log line that tipped us off: [2027-11-09T03:20:17Z] model-server-12 WARN kv_cache: evict key mismatch header=0x7b expected=0x6f size=8192
- PromQL I saved locally: sum(rate(kv_cache_evictions_total{job="model-server"}[1m])) by (model)
- Grafana overview panels: Ingress 5xx, Edge CPU %, KV cache hitrate, Model-server latency p50/p95/p99.

Final quick thought:
- This one felt like a small regressions chain (deploy + missing compat + cache churn). Need to push dev culture toward small, observable changes and explicit compatibility versions.

-- Lucian
